component.name: Dracular
component.summary: View and annotate documents, with dark mode built for reading

description.p: Dracular is an independent fork of Okular, KDE's universal document viewer, with a dark mode built for reading: text and backgrounds turn dark, images stay exactly as they are.

ul.li: Dark Reader mode for PDF and EPUB documents; embedded images are left untouched
Supported Formats: PDF, PS, Tiff, DjVu, Images, DVI, XPS, Fiction Book, Comic Book, Plucker, EPub, Fax
Sidebar with contents, thumbnails, reviews and bookmarks
